name: sflow-rt / prometheus-grafana
what_it_is: A Docker Compose stack that combines sflow-rt (a real-time sFlow analytics engine), Prometheus, and Grafana to collect network telemetry via sFlow and expose live dashboards. It is purpose-built for real-time network monitoring and visualization.
components: sflow-rt — sFlow collector and analytics engine that exports metrics to Prometheus
Prometheus — time-series metrics store with configurable retention
Grafana — dashboard and visualization layer pre-wired to Prometheus
protocols: sFlow (network telemetry sampling protocol, received by sflow-rt)
measurement: Real-time network traffic statistics via sFlow sampling
Time-series metrics stored in Prometheus (default 30-day retention)
configuration: RT_IMAGE — selects the sflow-rt Docker image variant (default: prometheus)
RTMEM — sets JVM heap memory for sflow-rt (default: 1G)
RTPROP — passes custom sflow-rt properties at startup (default: none)
DOCKER_USER — container UID:GID mapping (default: current user)
constraints: No built-in authentication or TLS configuration documented — the stack is plaintext by default
No high-availability or clustering support mentioned — single-node deployment only
sFlow traffic must be directed at the sflow-rt container; no passive pcap or SPAN-less capture
Memory for sflow-rt is bounded by RTMEM; large traffic volumes may require tuning
notable_absences: No fault injection or chaos tooling
No support for IPFIX, NetFlow, or other flow protocols — sFlow only
No horizontal scaling or HA mode
No alerting rules shipped by default
